import pathlib

g=[[9]*19 for _ in range(11)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(4,1),(5,1)]: g[r][c]=[7,1,7,7,7][r-1]
for r,c in [(2,3),(2,10),(2,16),(3,14),(4,7),(4,12),(7,5),(8,3),(8,9),(8,15),(8,18)]:g[r][c]=8

code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    targets=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    motif=[7,1,7,7,7]
    for r,c in targets:
        for k,v in enumerate(motif):
            rr=r+k-2
            if 0<=rr<len(out): out[rr][c]=v
